meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能在已装好的 Dial 通道上再加一个电话号码，让它成为独立的公共线路。每条线路有独立对话组，Claude 会用收到消息的那个号码回复，已有线路保持不变。
howto.when: 当 Dial 通道已安装好，你想给这个通道再添加一个电话号码（比如再加一条客服专线）时，就会用到这个技能。

say.text: 帮我在 Dial 通道上添加一个新号码
say.note: Claude 会引导你选择或购买号码并绑定代理组。

say.text: 我想再加一条客服专线，用新买的号码
say.note: Claude 会先让你购买号码，然后继续添加流程。

say.text: 给现有的 Dial 再加一个号码
say.note: Claude 会列出当前号码供你选择。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can add another phone number to an already-installed Dial channel, making it a separate public threaded line. Each line has its own messaging group and the agent replies from the number that received the message. Existing lines stay unchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Dial is already installed and the operator wants to add an extra number, e.g. a support line alongside a personal line.

say_en.text: Add a new number to my Dial channel.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to choose or buy a number and bind an agent group.

say_en.text: I want another support line, with a newly purchased number.
say_en.note: Claude will ask you to buy a number first, then continue.

say_en.text: Add one more number to the existing Dial setup.
say_en.note: Claude will list current numbers for you to pick.
